ruleContent.content: @js:var R='';try{var m=chapter.url.match(/(\d+)\|(\d+)\|([\w]+)(?:\|(\d+))?/);var spid=m[1],eid=m[2],vid=m[3],idx=Number(m[4]||0);var biz='video_id='+vid+'&episode_id='+eid+'&shortplay_id='+spid+'&lock_free=1';var o=_djxRpc('/shortplay/video_model',biz);if(o&&o.ret===10&&idx>0){_djxUnlock(spid,idx);o=_djxRpc('/shortplay/video_model',biz);}var vv=o&&o.data&&o.data.video_model&&o.data.video_model.video_list;if(vv&&vv.video_1&&vv.video_1.main_url){R=_u8ds(_b64dBytes(String(vv.video_1.main_url).replace(/-/g,'+').replace(/_/g,'/')));}else{R='无法获取播放地址：ret='+(o?o.ret:'?')+' msg='+(o?o.msg:'?');}}catch(e){R='播放地址获取异常：'+e.message;}R

ruleToc.chapterList: @js:try{var o=JSON.parse(decryptAES(result));var spid=o&&o.data?Number(o.data.thirdId||0):0;var d=_djxRpc('/shortplay/detail','shortplay_id='+spid+'&index=1&count=999&lock_free=1&not_include=0&direction=0');var arr=d&&d.data&&d.data.list?d.data.list:[];for(var i=0;i<arr.length;i++){arr[i]._spid=spid;}if(arr.length===0){arr=[{_spid:spid,_err:'detail ret='+d.ret+' msg='+d.msg,index:0,episode_id:0,vid:'',title:'目录为空:'+(d&&d.msg||'未知')}];}arr}catch(e){[{_spid:0,_err:String(e),index:0,episode_id:0,vid:'',title:'目录加载异常:'+e.message}]}
